Each case's `src` is wrapped into t.rs by `wrap(kind, src)` and compiled with `rustc +nightly-2026-10-11 -Zunpretty=ast-tree -Zui-testing --edition 2024 t.rs` (rustc 1.101.0-nightly (6f5da406b 2026-10-10)). `tree` is the subtree of the ast-tree dump for the node under test: kinds let/for/closure -> the first line matching /^( *)pat: Pat \{$/ (Local.pat / ForLoop.pat / the closure Param.pat) through the next line equal to `$1},`; block -> the `Block {` line right after `body: Some(` through its closing `},`; stmt -> the first `Stmt {` of that body's `stmts: [`; dedented, the field prefix dropped and the closing `},` written `}`. `stderr` is rustc's stderr minus the driver trailer (`error: aborting due to ..`, `rustc --explain` pointers). `exit` is rustc's exit status.
